observations: Q2 2026 revenue increased 17% year over year to $4.3B while Dupixent global net sales increased 38% and EYLEA HD U.S. net sales increased 52%.

For the six months ended June 30, 2026, combined EYLEA HD and EYLEA sales declined 17% year over year even as EYLEA HD grew, showing that franchise migration does not automatically eliminate legacy-product erosion.
The company identifies pending civil proceedings involving the U.S. Department of Justice/U.S. Attorney for Massachusetts and EYLEA-related patent litigation among material legal risks.
Regeneron states that EYLEA HD and EYLEA face significant marketplace competition and that competitors may have greater development, manufacturing, financial, marketing and human resources.
The filing states that changes in laws, regulations and healthcare policy can materially affect marketed-product sales.
For the six months ended June 30, 2026 aggregate U.S. EYLEA HD and EYLEA net product sales were $1.950B and represented 25% of total revenues, down from 33% in the prior-year period.
EYLEA U.S. net product sales declined 41% year over year for the first six months of 2026, while EYLEA HD represented 55% of combined U.S. EYLEA-family sales.
Regeneron states it remains substantially dependent on EYLEA-family revenue and expects biosimilar competition to continue increasing after EYLEA regulatory exclusivity expired in May 2024.
The filing warns that EYLEA HD growth may not sufficiently offset sustained EYLEA declines and that additional biosimilar launches can materially affect results.

contradictions.claim: EYLEA HD growth versus legacy EYLEA pressure
contradictions.resolution: Both can be true during franchise migration; treat as mix transition rather than a material unresolved contradiction.

contradictions.claim: EYLEA HD growth versus legacy EYLEA pressure
contradictions.resolution: Both are disclosed: franchise transition supports HD growth while competitive pressure and migration reduce legacy EYLEA demand.

contradictions.statement: Strong company-wide revenue growth and rapid Dupixent/EYLEA HD growth coexist with year-over-year decline in the combined EYLEA franchise for the first half of 2026.
contradictions.resolutionPath: Council Alpha should reflect franchise mix transition separately from consolidated growth when setting its own numeric risk treatment.

contradictions.statement: EYLEA HD is growing rapidly while legacy EYLEA declines materially; this is evidence of a franchise transition, not proof that concentration risk has disappeared.
contradictions.resolutionPath: Council Alpha should model combined franchise economics and diversification rather than extrapolating either HD growth or legacy decline in isolation.
